description: A Tauri-React desktop application for Windows, designed to configure the 'AbsoluteHOTAS.ini' file and synchronized 'ControlMap_Custom.txt' key bindings for the AbsoluteHOTAS Starfield input mod.

tech_stack.core: HTML5, Vanilla CSS, React (18.3.1) with Vite (8.0.11)

root.index.html: Vite entry point for the frontend.
root.src: Frontend React codebase (modularized under 500 lines per file).
root.src-tauri: Backend Rust codebase and Tauri configuration (modularized under 500 lines per file).

package.json.description: Vite & React frontend dependencies, along with Tauri CLI integration.

src/ini.js.description: Logic for parsing and building the `AbsoluteHOTAS.ini` file.
key_elements: axisRows: Array defining throttle, pitch, yaw, roll, strafe lateral, strafe vertical, and reverse slider axis fields.
defaults: Object with default config settings.
sections: Mapping of INI section names to key property lists.
parseKnownValues(text): Parses the INI content into a React-friendly config state.
buildIni(data, loadedIni): Serializes the React state back into a structured INI file.

src/shipActions.js.description: Definitions and helper functions for ship actions and physical buttons.
key_elements: keyboardOutputs / mouseOutputs: Scancodes and values for key:0xNN or mouse:N options.
shipActions: Definitions of the 23 named spaceship actions supported by AbsoluteHOTAS.
defaultShipBindings(): Generates an object initializing all physical ship actions to -1.
defaultShipOutputs(): Generates an object mapping all ship actions to their vanilla outputs.

src/main.jsx.description: React entry point serving as the central coordinator, state owner, and layout builder.
key_elements: App: Orchestrates central state hooks, file loading/saving pipelines, and device refresh timers.
applyChanges(changes): Sets global config state values.
loadIni() / saveIni(): Frontend-backend bridge for reading/writing configuration.
listenFor(kind, target): Arms the Rust recorder for axis/button binding.
Field: Layout textbox input for numerical and textual config values.

src/components/utils.js.description: Shared pure utility helper functions for device polling and binding mappings.
key_elements: isVJoyDevice(device): Performs case-insensitive name matching to isolate vJoy.
collectOutputCollisions(config): Detects redundant output mapping collisions across standard and custom actions.
axisControlFromUsage / buttonControlFromId: Resolves physical bindings to names.
deduplicateBindings(bindings): Strips duplicate scancode inputs within identical contexts to prevent game desyncs.

src/components/PathSettings.jsx.description: Native browse dialog and saving triggers panel.

src/components/HosasSettings.jsx.description: Manages detent calibrations, plateaus, ramping rates, unipolar throttle, always-on mode, and mutually exclusive deflection vs. keyboard pulsation toggles.

src/components/ExtraButtons.jsx.description: Collapsible extra button grid panel allowing mapping of physical DirectInput controls to scancode overrides outside standard layouts.

src/components/ShipActionsTable.jsx.description: Comprehensive named ship actions list displaying default scancodes, custom output options, and interactive secondary overrides recording triggers.

src/components/JoystickBindings.jsx.description: vJoy device inventory blocks, analog axis sensitivity / invert configuration lines, and digital key replacement fields.

src/styles.css.description: Vibrant custom dark-mode dashboard theme for the desktop configurator.

src-tauri/tauri.conf.json.description: Tauri v2 configuration file specifying window sizes, bundle details, and scripts.

src-tauri/Cargo.toml.description: Rust dependencies (serde, serde_json, windows crate with DirectInput support).

src-tauri/build.rs.description: Rust build script linking static DirectInput libraries.

src-tauri/src/main.rs.description: Application entrypoint, coordinating native Tauri builder and central command routing.

src-tauri/src/win_input.rs.description: Provides preview simulation bindings using native SendInput keyboard and mouse emulator macros.

src-tauri/src/control_map.rs.description: Custom parser, merge, backup, and serialized writer for the binary Starfield ControlMap_Custom.txt configurations.

src-tauri/src/direct_input/types.rs.description: Data structures representing device lists, sampled analog deflections, and captured bindings.

src-tauri/src/direct_input/devices.rs.description: DirectInput device lookup, polling queues, and Win32 character parsing utilities under target-level conditional windows annotations.

src-tauri/src/direct_input/recording.rs.description: DirectInput background recorder threads. The axis recorder samples rest noise baseline values, capturing deliberate analog motions resilient to sensor noise.

src-tauri/src/direct_input/mod.rs.description: Binds and exposes direct input scanner and listening functions to Tauri command scopes.

core_concepts.vjoy_only_target: The app assumes the target input device is 'vJoy' (case-insensitive product/instance name match) with a fallback to DirectInput index 0.
core_concepts.directinput_recorders: Rust uses a robust multi-device polling loop to detect axis and button updates. The axis recorder samples rest noise for 250ms first, then requires a deliberate movement above min threshold to select the axis.
core_concepts.sendinput_emulation: Emits Windows keyboard scancodes (scan code + extended key flags) or mouse click events via SendInput, allowing live testing of mapped keys directly from the UI.
core_concepts.button_expansion: Allows adding raw passthroughs where physical buttons on vJoy (1-128) emit keyboard scancodes or mouse outputs, without needing named ship action slots.
core_concepts.control_map_sync: Parsed ship actions and secondary overrides are natively parsed, merged structurally, and written back into Starfield's binary ControlMap_Custom.txt file. In-place backup generation ensures users never lose their layouts.
